description: Expected guard verdicts for every boundary in the ecosystem configuration, exercised as a cross-root matrix. expectBefore is the verdict under the configuration that predates the transformation being recorded, and must equal baseline.json; expectAfter is the verdict under the current configuration and is what check.php enforces.

codes.must-be: A symbol is barred from its namespace by a rule with must-be = []: a segment that repeats its parent, or a class named *Exception outside an Exception namespace.
codes.must-be-named: The symbol name does not match the rule's naming pattern.
codes.must-implement: The class does not implement the required interface.
codes.must-use-attribute: The class does not carry the required attribute.
codes.disallowed-use: A use statement names a dependency the perimeter restriction denies.
codes.disallowed-parameter-type: A parameter type names a dependency the perimeter restriction denies.

interface-name.note: Interfaces must follow the *Interface naming convention.

trait-name.note: Traits must follow the *Trait naming convention.

exception.note: New rule, and one statement in two halves: every class under Exception\ is named *Exception, and every class named *Exception lives under Exception\. The second half is a **\*Exception subject whose notOn is the Exception\ pattern. Both halves exclude the test roots, which cannot satisfy either clause: a PHPUnit class must end in Test.

repeat-segment.note: A namespace segment must not repeat its parent segment.

http-middleware.note: Http middleware lives in Http\Middleware and implements PSR-15 MiddlewareInterface. Test roots are exempt: a PHPUnit class named *Test cannot also be named *Middleware.

http-request-handler.note: Http request handlers live in Http\RequestHandler and implement PSR-15 RequestHandlerInterface. Test roots are exempt: a PHPUnit class named *Test cannot also be named *Handler.

command.note: Commands live in Command\, are named *Command, implement NamedCommandInterface, and are final.

command-handler.note: Command handlers live in CommandHandler\, are named *Handler, and implement CommandHandlerInterface.

query.note: Queries live in Query\, are named *Query, implement QueryInterface, and are final.

query-handler.note: Query handlers live in QueryHandler\, are named *Handler, and implement QueryHandlerInterface.

bus-middleware.note: Bus middleware lives in MessageBus\Middleware and implements the bus MiddlewareInterface. Test roots are exempt: a PHPUnit class named *Test cannot also be named *Middleware.

console-command.note: Console commands live in Console\, are named *Command, are final, and carry #[AsCommand].

event.note: Events live in Event\ and are named *Event.

listener.note: Listeners live in Listener\ and are named *Listener, with factories in Listener\Container\.

psr15.subjectBefore: allow-from {App,Webware}\**\Http\**, AppTest\**, AppTestIntegration\**, WebwareTest\**, WebwareTestIntegration\**, Webware\Async\**, Webware\Router\**
psr15.note: PSR-15 is reachable from any Http namespace and from any test root.

repository.subjectBefore: two restrictions, dependency Webware\**\Repository\** and dependency App\**\Repository\**
repository.note: Repositories are reachable from handlers, DI factories, console commands, the composition root, migration and tests. Merging the two root-specific restrictions is what gives a host application a persistence boundary over its own repositories.

phpdb.subjectBefore: allow-from with App\ and Webware\ entries and four enumerated test roots
phpdb.note: PhpDb stays behind the persistence boundary. The dependency is a package name, not a host root, so it is unchanged.

phpdb-validator.subjectBefore: allow-from with App\ and Webware\ entries and four enumerated test roots
phpdb-validator.note: Validators are attached to input filters.

symfony-console.subjectBefore: allow-from Webware\**\Console\**, App\**\Console\**, PhpDb\**\Console\**, four enumerated test roots
symfony-console.note: Symfony Console is reachable from a Console namespace and from tests.

messagebus-handler.note: Request handlers are render-only and never hold the bus.

usermanager.note: webware-acl must not depend on webware-usermanager. Package names, not host roots, so unchanged.
